title: Left-aligned web text performance versus fully justified text
statement:
Left-aligned web text produced better task performance than fully justified text in the tested visual-search tasks, although participants preferred justified text, so left alignment is the evidence-backed default while justification can remain a deliberate aesthetic choice.

Options:
- Performance default: text-align: left (fits: professional, accessible)
- Editorial justified: text-align: justify (fits: editorial, traditional)
- Hybrid: left-aligned body + justified special sections (fits: luxury, editorial)
- User choice: left-aligned body + user toggle (fits: accessible, customizable)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general web, web apps, editorial. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: The influence of line spacing and text alignment on visual search of web pages
